'''Sheela Foam Limited''' ('''SFL''') is an Indian multinational company that manufactures and supplies [[polyurethane foam]] mattresses and related comfort products. Sheela Foam operates across [[India]], [[Australia]], and [[Europe]], with 22 manufacturing facilities in these regions.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam Ltd Share Price |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/stocks/sheela-foam-ltd-sfl-share-price-365715 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=[[Business Today (India)|Business Today]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam Ltd |url=https://markets.ft.com/data/equities/tearsheet/profile?s=SFL:NSI |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=[[Financial Times]]}}</ref>
== History ==
Sheela Foam was established by Indian politician and entrepreneur [[Sheela Gautam]] in 1971 in [[Sahibabad]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], focusing initially on polyurethane foam production.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2024-05-19 |title=Exploring a Five-Decade-Old Company That Transformed the Way People Sleep in India |url=https://darkhorsestocks.com/archives/10724 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=Fundamentally strong companies |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Gautam - Founder & Chairperson at Sheela Foam Ltd |url=https://theorg.com/org/sheela-foam-ltd/org-chart/sheela-gautam |access-date=2025-07-25 |website= |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Rahul Gautam, Chair and Managing Director of Sheela Foam |url=https://www.theceomagazine.com/executive-interviews/retail-wholesale/rahul-gautam/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=The CEO Magazine |language=en-US}}</ref> In 1994, the company launched its flagship brand, Sleepwell,<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=_QIVAQAAMAAJ |title=Brands and Their Companies |date=2000 |publisher=Gale Research |isbn=978-0-7876-3323-3 |language=en}}</ref> which became a major mattress brand in India.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite journal |year=2009 |title=Sheela Foam |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=iTZWAAAAYAAJ&q=%22Sheela+Foam%22 |journal=India Today |volume=34 |issue=36 |via=University of Virginia}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Anderson |first=Ethan D. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=oeW_EAAAQBAJ&q=%22Sleep+Well+Tonight:+Your+Guide+to+Overcoming+Insomnia%22 |title=Sleep Well Tonight: Your Guide to Overcoming Insomnia |date=2023-01-01 |publisher=BornIncredible.com |isbn=978-1-77696-899-2 |language=en}}</ref> In 1995, Sheela Foam introduced specialized foam products for the [[Automotive industry|automotive]] and [[Healthcare industry|healthcare industries]].<ref name=":0" />

Between 1998 and 1999, the company introduced rubberized coir products Starlite and collaborated with Serta (USA), and [[Dunlop Rubber|Dunlopillo]] (UK), for mattress production.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-14 |title=Sheela Foam- Powering Comfort and Growth Through Strategic Acquisitions |url=https://forum.valuepickr.com/t/sheela-foam-powering-comfort-and-growth-through-strategic-acquisitions/147032 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=ValuePickr |language=en}}</ref> From 2001 to 2003, Sheela Foam established a polyurethane foam-producing plant in [[Greater Noida]] and expanded operations to [[Rajpura]], [[Punjab, India|Punjab]], and [[Sikkim]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Polyurethane (PU) Foam manufacturing in India |url=https://www.emech.com/IDN/case-study/general-engineering-industry-sheela-foam |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=ElectroMech}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam Limited - Manufacturer from Noida, India |url=https://www.indiamart.com/sheela-foam/company-brief.html?srsltid=AfmBOorlSFXTY5QBDwp_nbWfipSQW6aFFq5e8v8RbbskjdHI6W8K-5uz |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=indiamart.com}}</ref> In 2005, Sheela Foam made its first global acquisition by purchasing Joyce Foam, an Australian polyurethane foam manufacturer.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Mahanta |first=Vinod |date=2006-07-28 |title=Big dreams are made of these |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/big-dreams-are-made-of-these/articleshow/1820795.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-07-25 |work=[[The Economic Times]] |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> Between 2008 and 2010, Sheela Foam received multiple [[CIO (magazine)|CIO 100 Awards]] for IT excellence.<ref>{{Cite web |title=CIO 100 Award |url=https://www.cio.com/award/457890/us-cio-100-award-5-2010.html |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=CIO |language=en-US}}</ref> 

In 2016, the company was listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam Ltd |url=https://m.bseindia.com/StockReach.aspx?scripcd=540203 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220118233714/https://m.bseindia.com/StockReach.aspx?scripcd=540203 |archive-date=2022-01-18 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=m.bseindia.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=5 August 2024 |title=Sheela Foam stock price tanks 9% on weak Q1FY25 operational performance |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/sheela-foam-stock-price-tanks-9-on-weak-q1fy25-operational-performance-124080500320_1.html |access-date=25 June 2025 |website=Business Standard}}</ref>  and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jain |first=Vrathik |date=2024-11-28 |title=Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Going Into Trade On Nov. 28 |url=https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/stock-market-today-all-you-need-to-know-going-into-trade-on-nov-28-3 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=NDTV Profit |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-01-15 |title=Investors Appear Satisfied With Sheela Foam Limited's (NSE:SFL) Prospects |url=https://simplywall.st/stocks/in/consumer-durables/nse-sfl/sheela-foam-shares/news/investors-appear-satisfied-with-sheela-foam-limiteds-nsesfl |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=simplywall.st}}</ref> In 2017, the company received the PU Tech Innovation Award for its vertical variable pressure foaming technology.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam Ltd. |url=http://www.valoremadvisors.com/assets/admin/presentation_file/1711016001_Sheela_Foam_-_Investor_Presentation_-_March_2024.pdf |access-date=25 June 2025 |website=valoremadvisors.com}}</ref> In 2018, Sheela Foam`s corporate office in Noida received [[LEED|Platinum LEED Certification]] for sustainability. The same year, Sheela Foam was named ''[[Business Standard]]'' Star SME of the Year.<ref>{{Cite web |date=April 3, 2018 |title=Sheela Foam Limited has been awarded as "Star SME of the year" by Business Standard |url=https://www.sheelafoam.com/corporate-announcement/2018/intimation-03-april-2018.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220812234158/https://www.sheelafoam.com/corporate-announcement/2018/intimation-03-april-2018.pdf |archive-date=2022-08-12 |access-date=25 June 2025 |website=sheelafoam.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=History of Sheela Foam Ltd., Company |url=https://www.goodreturns.in/company/sheela-foam/history.html#1750789800 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=Goodreturn |language=en}}</ref>

In 2019, Sheela Foam entered the European market by acquiring Interplasp S.L.U., a Spanish [[polyether]] foam manufacturer.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam set to acquire Spanish firm Interplasp |url=https://www.dsij.in/dsijarticledetail/sheela-foam-set-to-acquire-spanish-firm-interplasp-8586 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=Dalal Street Investment Journal |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Sleepwell mattress maker Sheela Foam to acquire Spanish firm Interplasp |url=https://www.vccircle.com/sleepwell-mattress-maker-sheela-foam-to-acquire-spanish-firm-interplasp |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2021, the company received the India Manufacturing Excellence Award for its PU foam manufacturing.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam's Rahul Gautam Recognized Among '100 Great IITians' For Nation-Building Legacy |url=https://infashionbusiness.com/home/news_details/3051/9 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=infashionbusiness.com |language=en}}</ref> In 2023, Sheela Foam acquired Kurl-On, an Indian rubberized coir mattress manufacturer,<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-07-17 |title=India's Sheela Foam to buy mattress maker Kurlon for $262 mln |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/indias-sheela-foam-buy-mattress-maker-kurlon-262-mln-2023-07-17/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |work=Reuters |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Jain |first=Aniruddha |date=2023-08-18 |title=Sheela Foam strategic acquisitions to firm its hold in India |url=https://mnacritique.mergersindia.com/sheela-foam-kurlon-furlenco-acquisition/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |language=en-US}}</ref> and invested in Furlenco, an online furniture rental company.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Morning Context: Internet, Business, Chaos |url=https://themorningcontext.com/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=The Morning Context |language=en}}</ref> 

Sheela Foam is a member of the Indian Sleep Products Federation (ISPF)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Indian Sleep Products Federation |url=https://ispf.co.in/ |access-date=25 June 2025 |website=ISPF}}</ref> and the Indian Polyurethane Association (IPUA).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sheela Foam Appoints Rahul Gautam as Chairman and Tushaar Gautam as MD |url=https://boardstewardship.com/sheela-foam-appoints-rahul-gautam-as-chairman-and-tushaar-gautam-as-md/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=boardstewardship.com}}</ref>

== Operations ==
The company’s brands and subsidiaries include Sleepwell, the Indian mattress and home comfort brand; Kurl-On, which specializes in rubberized coir mattresses; and Furlenco, an online furniture and home decor provider. Globally, Sheela Foam owns Joyce Foam Pty Ltd in Australia, a polyurethane foam manufacturer, and Interplasp S.L.U., a Spanish polyether foam producer.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Jain |first=Aniruddha |date=2023-08-18 |title=Sheela Foam strategic acquisitions to firm its hold in India |url=https://mnacritique.mergersindia.com/sheela-foam-kurlon-furlenco-acquisition/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Sreedhar |first=Vidya |date=2023-07-17 |title=Sleepwell parent to acquire Kurl-On and Furlenco for Rs 2,035 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/sleepwell-parent-to-acquire-kurl-on-furlenco-brands-to-expand-offering-market-share/articleshow/101832127.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-07-25 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> 

Sheela Foam invests in digital transformation through its subsidiary, STAQO Technologies. This subsidiary develops enterprise technologies, automation, and digital workflow optimization for manufacturing and retail operations. The company carries out corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives under the Sleepwell Foundation. In June 2020, Sleepwell partnered with the Indian government to donate 10,000 bedding units—including mattresses, pillows, and beds—for COVID-19 relief efforts.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2020-06-24 |title=CSR News: Sleepwell donates 10,000 bedding units to support the nation in its fight against COVID-19 |url=https://thecsrjournal.in/sleepwell-donates-bedding-units-covid-19/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=The CSR Journal |language=en-US}}</ref>
== Research and development ==
Sheela Foam developed Variable Pressure Foaming (VPF) technology, a manufacturing process that eliminates harmful emissions.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Singh |first1=Vratika |last2=Gopalasamudram |first2=Mahesh N |last3=Maitra |first3=Jaya |date=2025-03-01 |title=Investigating the physico-mechanical and thermal properties of flexible polyurethane foams made with standard and special polyols produced by the variable pressure foaming technique |url=https://doi.org/10.1177/0021955X251314036 |journal=Journal of Cellular Plastics |language=EN |volume=61 |issue=2 |pages=81–102 |doi=10.1177/0021955X251314036 |issn=0021-955X|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=VPF Variable Pressure Foaming - FXI Innovations |url=http://lcsg.foamex.com/solutions/innovationstories/variable-pressure-foam.php |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=lcsg.foamex.com}}</ref> The company also collaborated with RMIT University, Australia, to create Pro Nexa Technology, which improves pressure relief and body support compared to conventional memory foam.

The company introduced the Sleepwell Tarang Mattress, designed as an affordable alternative to traditional cotton mattresses,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Which mattress brand is best in India? Comparing Wakefit, Duroflex, and Sleepwell |url=https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/impact-feature/which-mattress-brand-is-best-in-india-comparing-wakefit-duroflex-and-sleepwell/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=The Tribune |language=en}}</ref> and the Sleepwell Pro FitRest Mattress, which is recommended by the Indian Association of Physiotherapists for muscle recovery.<ref>{{Cite web |date=January 14, 2025 |title=Why sleep matters for women's health: the role of healthy sleep mattresses |url=https://www.business-standard.com/content/specials/why-sleep-matters-for-women-s-health-the-role-of-healthy-sleep-mattresses-125011400312_1.html |website=[[Business Standard]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Introducing Sleepwell Pro FitRest Mattress With 25 Years Warranty. |url=https://storesnearme.mysleepwell.com/sleepwell/mattress-stores-in-nawada/mattress-stores-in-main-road/sleepwell-exclusive-dealer-adhunik-fashion-in-main-road-nawada--13a26fcb-8c50-4d50-bbbd-f91d4465e4d2/articles/introducing-sleepwell-pro-fitrest-mattress-with-25-years-warranty-sleepwellmattress-comfort-mattress-aisiaisiwaalic--1af731a0-22c6-447c-aa70-aad25451fabf |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=mysleepwell.com |language=en}}</ref> The Sleepwell Pro Spinetech Mattress, developed in collaboration with the Indian Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons, is designed to supports spinal health.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jamwal |first=Shivangi |date=February 13, 2025 |title=Best Mattresses For Back Pain: Sleep Properly & Say Goodbye To Pain - The Times Reviews |url=https://reviews.indiatimes.com/hot-picks/best-mattresses-for-back-pain-sleep-properly-say-goodbye-to-pain/articleshow/109082694.cms |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=The Times of India |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Kirtonia |first=Dev |date=2025-01-07 |title=How Sleepwell Pro Spinetech Luxury mattress supports your spine for healthier sleep |url=https://devlibrary.in/sleepwell-pro-spinetech-luxury-mattress |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=Dev Library |language=en-US}}</ref>
